title: Vendetta for the Saint
writer: Leslie Charteris, Harry W. Junkin, John Kruse
actors: Roger Moore, Ian Hendry, Rosemary Dexter
plot: Set against an appealingly sunny Sicilian backdrop, this movie finds Simon Templar, an elegant thief and ethical busybody, outraged when a British banker is murdered after he recognizes an old colleague-turned-Mafia kingpin.
